q-39429.name: Question 1
q-39429.problem: Consider the vector $u=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3 \\ \sqrt{k} \\ 1\end{aligned}].$ Given that $u\cdot v=-10$ and $‖v‖=2$,  what is the smallest possible value of $k?$
q-39429.worked_solution:
We will use the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality,

$$
|u\cdot v|\le ‖u‖\cdot ‖v‖.
$$

We are given all the quantities in the inequality above, except for $‖u‖.$ So first, we compute $‖u‖$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}‖u‖ & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+{3}^{2}+(\sqrt{k})^{2}+{1}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{14+k}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|u\cdot v| & \le ‖u‖\cdot ‖v‖ \\ |-10| & \le \sqrt{14+k}\cdot (2) \\ 5 & \le \sqrt{14+k} \\ {5}^{2} & \le {(\sqrt{14+k})}^{2} \\ 25 & \le 14+k \\ 11 & \le k.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the smallest possible value of $k$ is $11.$

π3
d
 π8
e
 π4

EXPLANATION

Using the formula

cos⁡θ=v⋅w‖v‖‖w‖,

we have the following:

cos⁡θ=v1w1+v2w2+v3w3+v4w4v12+v22+v32+v42w12+w22+w32+w42=(−2)(1)+(1)(2)+(−2)(−5)+(3)(2)(−2)2+12+(−2)2+3212+(2)2+(−5)2+22=161632=432=12=22

Therefore, θ=arccos⁡(22)=π4.

q-74096.name: Question 4
q-74096.problem: Consider the vector $u=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ \sqrt{k} \\ -1\end{aligned}].$ Given that $u\cdot v=16$ and $‖v‖=4$, what is the smallest possible value of $k?$
q-74096.worked_solution:
We will use the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality,  

$$
|u\cdot v|\le ‖u‖\cdot ‖v‖.
$$

We are given all the quantities in the inequality above, except for $‖u‖.$ So first, we compute $‖u‖$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}‖u‖ & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+(-1)^{2}+(\sqrt{k})^{2}+(-1)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{k+6}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|u\cdot v| & \le ‖u‖\cdot ‖v‖ \\ |16| & \le \sqrt{k+6}\cdot (4) \\ 4 & \le \sqrt{k+6} \\ {4}^{2} & \le (\sqrt{k+6})^{2} \\ 16 & \le k+6 \\ 10 & \le k.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the smallest possible value of $k$ is $10.$

q-140444.html:
Question 5
?

Rounded to two decimal places, what is the acute angle between the vectors v=[−1205] and w=[44−20]?

a
86.22∘
b
72.45∘
c
83.01∘
d
75.28∘
e
65.86∘
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Using the formula

cos⁡θ=v⋅w‖v‖‖w‖,

we have the following:

cos⁡θ=v1w1+v2w2+v3w3+v4w4v12+v22+v32+v42w12+w22+w32+w42=(−1)⋅4+2⋅4+0⋅(−2)+5⋅012+(−2)2+02+5242+42+(−2)2+02=430⋅36=4630=2330

Therefore,

θ=arccos⁡(2330)≈83.01∘.
